data.gender_notes: Anooshah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anooshah is derived from the Arabic root word 'anasha', which means 'to deliver, save, or liberate'. This name is mentioned in the Quran and is given to a female character who is described as one who guides others to the right path. It is a spiritual name that represents hope, guidance, and salvation. The name Anooshah carries the meaning “Liberation, Salvation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anooshah usually hope their child will grow to embody liberation, salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anooshah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberation, Salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anooshah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
